commands.command:
cat > /tmp/add_rules.py <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, shutil
path = '/conf/config.xml'
shutil.copy(path, path + '.bak2')
tree = ET.parse(path)
root = tree.getroot()
filt = root.find('filter')

def mkrule(rtype, iface, proto, srcnet, dstnet, dstport, descr, log):
    r = ET.SubElement(filt, 'rule')
    ET.SubElement(r, 'type').text = rtype
    ET.SubElement(r, 'ipprotocol').text = 'inet'
    if proto:
        ET.SubElement(r, 'protocol').text = proto
    ET.SubElement(r, 'descr').text = descr
    ET.SubElement(r, 'interface').text = iface
    if log:
        ET.SubElement(r, 'log').text = '1'
    src = ET.SubElement(r, 'source')
    ET.SubElement(src, 'network').text = srcnet
    dst = ET.SubElement(r, 'destination')
    ET.SubElement(dst, 'network').text = dstnet
    if dstport:
        ET.SubElement(dst, 'port').text = dstport
    return r

# Block/refuse telnet (tcp/23) between lan-a (opt1) and lan-b (opt2), logged, evaluated before the general pass rules.
mkrule('reject', 'opt1', 'tcp', 'opt1', 'opt2', '23', 'antrieb: refuse telnet lan-a to lan-b', True)
mkrule('reject', 'opt2', 'tcp', 'opt2', 'opt1', '23', 'antrieb: refuse telnet lan-b to lan-a', True)

# General pass rules so other routed traffic between lan-a/lan-b (and onward) still works.
mkrule('pass', 'opt1', None, 'opt1', 'any', None, 'antrieb: allow lan-a to any', False)
mkrule('pass', 'opt2', None, 'opt2', 'any', None, 'antrieb: allow lan-b to any', False)

tree.write(path, xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')
print('rules added')
PY

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, shutil
path = '/conf/config.xml'
shutil.copy(path, path + '.bak3')
tree = ET.parse(path)
root = tree.getroot()
filt = root.find('filter')

    net = dst.find('network')
